name: Gemscale · Gremlet #32
description:
A moonstone dragon that grows crystals instead of spikes. They chime when it runs.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Gemscale in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
